title: Dark Rum Bread Pudding
description: Cinnamon-vanilla bread pudding with a golden top and warm brown-butter and brown sugar dark rum sauce.
imageAlt: Golden bread pudding with dark rum sauce on a terracotta plate

items: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter, for the pan
10 ounces day-old French bread, cut in 1-inch cubes (about 8 cups)
¾ cup packed light brown sugar
½ cup packed light brown sugar

steps.title: Prepare the bread
steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Butter a 9-inch square baking dish and spread the bread cubes in it.

steps.title: Soak the bread
steps.text: Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, brown sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt until smooth. Pour the custard over the bread and gently press down any dry pieces. Soak for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Bake until set
steps.text: Bake for 40–50 minutes, until the top is golden and the center is set and registers at least 160°F. Let the pudding rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

steps.title: Brown the sauce butter
steps.text: While the pudding rests, melt the 4 tablespoons sauce butter in a small light-colored saucepan over medium-low heat. Stir across the bottom until the foam reveals hazelnut-brown flecks and a toasted aroma. Immediately pour it all into a heatproof bowl.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: With the pan off the heat, add the cream, brown sugar, salt and browned butter, scraping in the toasted flecks. Return to medium-low heat and whisk at a gentle simmer for 3–4 minutes until smooth. Move the pan away from the burner before stirring in the measured dark rum.

steps.title: Serve warm
steps.text: Cut the pudding into squares and spoon the warm dark rum sauce over each serving. The sauce contains alcohol.
